events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Claudius is emperor (AD 41 to 54); Thessalonica is the capital of Macedonia.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written probably from Corinth, about AD 51 (if by Paul)

teaser.title: 1 Thessalonians is sent
teaser.text: Paul writes from Corinth, about AD 50 to 51.

teaser.title: 2 Thessalonians is written
teaser.text: A few months later (if by Paul), the same three writers follow up.

teaser.title: Paul moves on
teaser.text: Paul leaves Corinth after about eighteen months (Acts 18:11, 18:18).
